domain-information: An Archivist evaluates incoming documents and organizes them into relevant collections to maintain order
An Archivist creates descriptive metadata to make documents easy to find for future reference
A Records Manager oversees the storage of official municipal records and ensures proper filing procedures
A Records Manager updates digital catalogs to reflect newly archived materials
A Research Assistant assists visitors in locating historical records and government documents
A Research Assistant compiles copies of requested documents to support research or legal needs
A Public Services Officer responds to citizen inquiries and guides them on accessing public records
A Public Services Officer coordinates document requests
A Citizen searches the archive catalog online and requests access to birth certificates, permits, or historical reports
A Citizen submits formal document requests to support personal research or legal matters

domain objects.name: Archivist
domain objects.description: Person who evaluates and organizes incoming documents

domain objects.name: Document
domain objects.description: Any item stored in the archive with descriptive metadata

domain objects.name: Metadata
domain objects.description: Descriptive information created to help locate a Document

domain objects.name: Collection
domain objects.description: Group of related Documents organized for easier access

domain objects.name: Records Manager
domain objects.description: Person who oversees municipal records and keeps filing procedures in order

domain objects.name: Municipal Record
domain objects.description: Official record maintained by the municipality

domain objects.name: Research Assistant
domain objects.description: Person who helps visitors find documents and prepares research copies

domain objects.name: Copy
domain objects.description: Reproduced version of a Document for research or legal use

domain objects.name: Public Services Officer
domain objects.description: Person who handles citizen inquiries and coordinates Document Requests

domain objects.name: Citizen Inquiry
domain objects.description: Question submitted by a Citizen about how to find or access records

domain objects.name: Document Request
domain objects.description: Formal request for access to specific documents

domain objects.name: Citizen
domain objects.description: Individual who searches catalogs and requests documents

domain objects.name: Access Request
domain objects.description: Request submitted by a Citizen to obtain access to a Document
